description: If Mordekaiser ults Illaoi or a target tethered by her E, the spirit stays outside the Death Realm — her strongest pressure tool does not follow into the realm.
timing_note: Relevant both in lane and teamfights; Morde can ult specifically to strip an active E.

description: Sylas can steal Death Realm. A stolen realm isolates any target from their team, and no one outside can interact — a threat to Mordekaiser's entire team, not just Mordekaiser.
timing_note: Threat is active whenever Sylas has ult available; track his R cooldown.

description: Aurelion Sol's Q is a channeled beam, not a projectile — Wind Wall does not block it.
timing_note: Do not hold or waste W for the beam; it will pass through regardless.

description: Milio R cleanses Lillia's ult from all allies in radius — including during the drowsy phase, before sleep ever lands.
timing_note: Sleep is cast-inhibiting but drowsy is not: if Lillia's ult catches Milio himself, he must R during his own drowsy phase — once asleep, he cannot cast at all. If it catches only allies, he can cleanse them freely even after sleep lands. Lillia should aim to include Milio in the ult; Milio must react within the drowsy window when hit.

description: Lulu E grants True Sight of its target — a Vayne tagged by E stays visible through her R+Q invisibility.
timing_note: The reveal lasts 4 seconds — tag Vayne as she commits; she can wait out an early tag before tumbling.

description: Yasuo W blocks Illaoi E — the spirit-pull tendril is a projectile and can be denied entirely.
timing_note: Wall must be up before the tendril reaches its target.

description: Yasuo W blocks the chain throw of Sylas E (second cast), denying his primary engage — chains don't read as projectiles but count as one.
timing_note: Only the second cast (chain throw) is blockable; the first dash is not.

description: Yasuo W does not block Aurelion Sol R — it is ground-targeted impact, not a projectile.
Yasuo W does not block Lux R — it is an instant beam, not a projectile.
Yasuo W does not block Senna R — the global beam passes through.
Yasuo W does not block Vel'Koz R — channeled beams are not projectiles.
Yasuo W does not block Xerath Q, W, or R (artillery, not projectiles) — only Xerath E is a blockable projectile.
timing_note: E is Xerath's only stun — blocking it removes his pick threat, but his damage still lands through the wall.

description: Yasuo W does not block Mordekaiser E — the pull is ground-targeted, not a missile.
Yasuo W blocks Vayne E — the condemn bolt, its knockback, and the stun are all denied if the wall intercepts it.
timing_note: Wall must be between Yasuo and Vayne when the bolt fires.

description: A spell shield fully cancels Morde R — if Sivir E or Nocturne W is up when the cast completes, the ult is wasted entirely, not delayed.
timing_note: Shield must be active at the moment the cast finishes; baiting the cast then shielding denies the whole ult.

description: Karthus R hits champions in every realm — being inside (or dragging someone into) the Death Realm does not dodge it.
Kalista R cannot be cast while her Oathsworn is in another realm — Morde ulting either half of the pair severs their ult combo.
timing_note: Applies for the full realm duration; strongest against engage comps built around Kalista R.

description: Morde ulting Yasuo mid-Last Breath yanks him into the Death Realm and interrupts the ult — unless Yasuo's target is Morde himself, in which case both enter and it continues.
timing_note: Reactive play: requires Morde R available and quick hands during Yasuo's engage.

description: Tahm R cannot rescue anyone from the Death Realm — he can carry a devoured ally past the border, but they are displaced back inside when spat out.
